description: Compare public digital-art / NFT records (marketplace listing, block explorer, artist catalogue) field by field. Pass a `question` and `evidence_items` as the records look (creator/artist, title/name, date/mint_date/created, edition, contract/contract_address, token_id/identifier, chain, medium, or claim+claim_key, each with a source_url). Returns per-field AGREES / CONFLICT / SINGLE_SOURCE with values by source, what evidence would resolve each conflict, a CONSISTENT / CONFLICTS_FOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict and a receipt. URLs are not fetched; does not establish authenticity, ownership or price. Free, read-only, no account. Inputs must be public and non-personal; calling declares that (data_classification defaults to PUBLIC).

examples.question: Do these public records agree on the creator and the edition?

name: evaluate_public_art_evidence
